title: spec(ui): the dashboard widget describe does not say that a dataset tile the server refuses as a read refusal is left out for that viewer; `requiresObject` keeps its install-only meaning
body:
Filing gate **① a defect with a named location**: shipped spec prose does not describe what a viewer is shown. This is follow-up owed by landed work, the spec half of #26971 (its Acceptance item 2: "The spec describes the chosen key or behaviour, and `requiresObject` keeps its install-only meaning"). ui seat 2 split it off because a `packages/spec/src/**` diff sits behind the Clause-② queue gate's path limb.

`finding` class **b** · `reach:` named producer: PR #27065 (`Refs #26971 (item 1)`, ui seat 2 review pending). Outside design mode, `DashboardRenderer` now leaves a dataset-bound tile out of the layout once the server refuses its query as a read refusal (403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED`, via `classifyLoadError`). Design mode and the editable `DashboardGridLayout` keep the tile and its objectui#10899 no-access state.

## What is missing (read at `origin/main` `cb8988ee`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` ≈L1149, `DashboardWidget.requiresObject`: "Hide the widget unless the named object is registered". Nothing on the widget schema tells an author what a viewer who may not read a tile's data sees. Authors asked for a widget key (hotcrm#2338) because the spec does not say the renderer handles it. Triage 6456651336 ruled out a new key.
- The os-dev report on #26971 (comment 6460010220, `out_of_scope_findings`) proposes a sibling sentence: "A dataset-bound widget whose query the server refuses as a read refusal (403 PERMISSION_DENIED) is left out of the dashboard for that viewer outside design mode; requiresObject stays an install gate."
- `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json` ≈L157 (`requiresObject`) may want the same note. Re-read it.

## Expected

The widget describe (and, if the lane's convention wants it, the `DashboardSchema` describe ≈L1755, which lists `requiresObject` / `requiresService`) states the read-refusal behaviour in one sentence and keeps `requiresObject` as the install gate. This changes prose only. No key and no accept-set change.

## Business reason

App authors decide from this schema whether they must split a dashboard per audience. Without the sentence they keep building workarounds (HotCRM hid nothing and kept a broken tile) for a case the renderer now handles.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:spec` seat, in one PR to `dashboard.zod.ts` (plus liveness if needed), after PR #27065 merges.

## Dedupe

I listed `domain:spec` issues (state all, the newest 300) and checked titles for dashboard / widget / requiresObject. I found 0 hits on this behaviour. #26602 (KPI polarity) and #25391 (`nullLabel`) are unrelated.
